Full-time Engineering Technologist position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Macquarie Park, NSW 2113. Apply today through 11 Recruitment!

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Engineering Technologist
•	$80,000 – $85,000 p.a. plus superannuation
•	Work in a professional environment.

Position Overview:
Alpha Mechanical Group Pty Ltd – A trusted provider of mechanical engineering services and industrial project solutions, committed to delivering reliable service, technical excellence, and high-quality engineering outcomes. With a focus on innovation, system efficiency, and continuous improvement, the team supports projects through practical and effective engineering solutions.

As an Engineering Technologist at Alpha Mechanical Group Pty Ltd, you will be responsible for analysing, evaluating, modifying, and implementing engineering technologies to support the design, testing, installation, commissioning, and optimisation of mechanical and HVAC systems across a range of projects. This position requires strong technical knowledge, analytical problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to apply engineering principles to practical project environments.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Analyse mechanical and HVAC technologies to determine their effectiveness, suitability, and compatibility with residential, commercial, and industrial project requirements.
•	Develop and refine engineering methods, equipment configurations, and system designs to improve operational efficiency, reliability, and overall mechanical system performance.
•	Plan and conduct technical testing of mechanical systems, components, and engineered solutions to verify functionality before installation, commissioning, or project deployment.
•	Support the implementation of engineering innovations by integrating upgraded technologies into new and existing mechanical and HVAC installations.
•	Investigate system performance data, identify technical deficiencies, and recommend practical engineering enhancements to achieve optimal project outcomes.
•	Prepare detailed engineering documentation, including technical assessments, testing records, specifications, drawing mark-ups, and implementation reports to support project delivery.
•	Work closely with engineers, project managers, subcontractors, suppliers, and installation teams to ensure engineering solutions are effectively incorporated into project execution.
•	Monitor commissioning activities and operational performance of HVAC and mechanical systems, recommending adjustments to improve energy efficiency, safety, and long-term reliability.
•	Review engineering processes and project workflows to identify opportunities for innovation, continuous improvement, cost control, and greater productivity across mechanical engineering operations.
•	Ensure engineering activities, technology applications, and project implementation comply with relevant Australian standards, safety regulations, quality requirements, and client specifications.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualifications in Engineering or a related discipline.
•	Minimum 1 year of experience as an Engineering Technologist.
•	Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, HVAC systems, and practical engineering applications.
•	Ability to analyse, evaluate, modify, and improve engineering systems, equipment, and processes.
•	Experience supporting testing, implementation, commissioning, and optimisation of engineering technologies.
•	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, engineering documentation, and project requirements.
•	Strong communication, teamwork, problem-solving, and organisational skills.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $80,000 – $85,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

result.description:
About the Company

OnSpec DAQ Pty Ltd is an Australian company delivering intelligent and innovative engineering solutions to the Oil & Gas industry. The company specialises in wireline services, data acquisition systems, reservoir evaluation and engineering support, providing high-quality technical services through safe, efficient and innovative operational practices.

Our commitment is to deliver engineering excellence while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and environmental responsibility across all operations.

The Role

OnSpec is seeking an experienced Petroleum Engineer – Logging Technician (Wireline Services) to join our team in Chinchilla, Queensland.

This permanent full-time role combines petroleum engineering responsibilities with specialist wireline logging operations. The successful applicant will support reservoir evaluation, drilling, well completion, production optimisation and well intervention activities while providing technical leadership during wireline field operations.

The position requires a strong understanding of petroleum engineering principles together with practical experience in wireline logging services to support clients throughout exploration and production operations.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, design and optimise well intervention and reservoir evaluation programs to maximise hydrocarbon recovery.
Analyse geological, petrophysical and reservoir data to support drilling, completion and production decisions.
Develop engineering solutions to improve well productivity and operational efficiency.
Monitor well performance and recommend remedial actions based on engineering analysis.
Design and evaluate well completion and production strategies in accordance with engineering standards.
Provide technical support during drilling, completion and intervention operations.
Assess operational risks and ensure compliance with Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) requirements.
Prepare engineering reports, technical recommendations and operational documentation.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including geologists, drilling engineers and production engineers.
Review operational results and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Operate wireline logging equipment to obtain accurate downhole formation and well integrity data.
Conduct open-hole and cased-hole logging operations in accordance with company procedures and client specifications.
Perform equipment testing, calibration and functional checks before field operations.
Interpret logging data to support reservoir evaluation and well diagnostics.

Purpose – 
This role will lead the presales and solution consulting function for the organisation's enterprise SaaS platforms. Working at the intersection of sales, product and customers, the role is responsible for translating complex business requirements into tailored, value-led software solutions that win and grow strategic enterprise accounts. You will lead a team of solution consultants, and acts as the senior technical and commercial advisor throughout the enterprise sales cycle, with a particular focus on growth across the Asia-Pacific region, including Australia and New Zealand.

Key Responsibilities -
Solution Strategy & Deal Leadership
•	Define and own the presales and solution strategy for assigned enterprise and growth accounts across the product portfolio.
•	Lead customer discovery and requirement-gathering engagements, analysing current-state processes and designing target-state software solutions. 
•	Architect and present complex, multi-product solutions tailored to each customer's operational and commercial context. 
•	Engage senior and executive (CXO-level) stakeholders, articulating solution value through demonstrations, presentations and structured value narratives.
•	Develop return-on-investment and business-impact models that support commercial justification and value-led purchasing decisions. 
•	Support the sales organisation in qualifying, shaping and progressing opportunities through a substantial enterprise pipeline.

Team Leadership & Capability Development
•	Lead, coach and develop a team of senior presales / solution consultants, setting performance standards and supporting career growth.
•	Establish presales best practices, methodologies and quality standards for deliverables across the team.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Market Engagement.
•	Partner with the product organisation to channel structured customer feedback and influence roadmap priorities. 
•	Collaborate with sales, product, delivery and commercial teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, deliverable and commercially viable.
•	Represent the organisation at industry events, forums and customer engagements to support pipeline generation and market visibility.

Selection Criteria – Skills, Qualifications & Experience
•	A bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline; a postgraduate management qualification is highly regarded.
•	Significant experience in enterprise SaaS presales, solution consulting or value engineering, including time in a leadership capacity.
•	Demonstrated success supporting and winning large, complex enterprise deals, ideally across multiple international markets.
•	Strong consultative selling, requirement-analysis, solution-design and commercial value-articulation skills.
•	Proven people-leadership experience, including managing and developing presales or solution-consulting teams.
•	Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, including engagement at executive level.
•	Familiarity with applying modern technologies, including generative AI, to sales and solution workflows.
•	Domain exposure to logistics, supply chain or comparable enterprise software environments is advantageous.

Scope -
The role leads a team of senior presales consultants. It carries accountability for solution outcomes on the organisation's most strategic enterprise opportunities and works closely with regional sales leadership to support revenue growth and market expansion across Asia-Pacific.
